answer: Because the oasis derivation is checked against the zephyr nonce, the quill audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 176 aliases produces 176 mismatches and forfeits the authoring cost with no payout. An answer must include the first 30 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
